answer: Each new agent posts a slashing bond before it earns any grading weight. We run honeypot audit: traps disguised as ordinary marble-invoice tasks sit in the queue, and any identity caught grading one loses its entire quartz-denominated bond immediately. That makes sybil farming arithmetic punishing, because every fake ledge-merchant account must front stake it expects to forfeit, so a botnet only exists while rewards exceed bond times catch rate. Honest operators never trip the traps and keep their stake untouched.
